description: Source code for E1 network client factory, including classes for converting E1AP PDUs between packed and unpacked forms, and establishing SCTP network connections for E1 communication.

classes.name: sctp_to_e1_pdu_notifier
classes.description: Converts packed E1AP PDUs from E1 GW into unpacked PDUs and forwards to CU-UP.

classes.name: e1_to_sctp_pdu_notifier
classes.description: Converts unpacked E1AP PDUs from CU-UP into packed PDUs and forwards to SCTP gateway.

classes.name: e1_sctp_gateway_client
classes.description: Manages SCTP connection for E1 network, handling connection requests and data forwarding.

methods.name: on_new_sdu
methods.description: Handles new SCTP SDU, unpacks E1AP PDU, and forwards to CU-UP.

methods.name: on_new_message
methods.description: Handles new E1AP message, packs into SCTP SDU, and forwards.

methods.name: handle_cu_up_connection_request
methods.description: Establishes SCTP connection to CU-CP and returns PDU notifier.
